messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — final check for annual SOC2/ISO evidence and the privacy attestation window. We're running a "fastlane" for straightforward uploads and an "exceptions" lane for cases that need legal/infra help. Fastlane owners: please upload all artifacts and mark the attestation checkbox by EOD Friday. Docs + checklist: https://redwood.company/compliance/attestation-2026 :link: 

oliver: Uploaded infra diagrams and key-rotation logs to the shared compliance folder (/compliance/dropbox/infra). Pinged the folder for access — @maria please confirm visibility. :white_check_mark:

jenna: I have two services where change logs are incomplete due to a migration. Can I request an exception window? 

maria: Yes — open an exceptions ticket on the Compliance board (project: COM-ATT). Tag @maria and pick the "attestation-exception" template so we get legal + infra triage. We'll review during office hours tomorrow (link below). :spiral_calendar:

sam: FYI legal needs to review one artifact for PII redaction before it can be posted. @jenna can you highlight which file needs review when you open the ticket?

ciso-bot: Automated reminder: 48 hours remaining for "fastlane" owners to upload evidence and complete attestations. See https://redwood.company/compliance/attestation-2026/checklist.

maria: If anyone hits SSO/permissions errors while uploading, DM @oliver — he patched a permissions issue earlier today. Also note we will snapshot evidence at 2026-04-01 18:00 PT; anything not uploaded by that time will require an exceptions request. :clock3:

oliver: Confirming — I fixed a group-perms bug; try now and ping me if it still fails. Command I used to re-sync group membership: `rbac sync --group compliance-uploaders` (internal tool).

jenna: I re-uploaded sanitized logs and added a comment in the ticket for legal review. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :pray:

maria: Thanks everyone — last push here. We'll close the fastlane snapshot and circulate a short summary to execs after the snapshot. If you're blocked, flag it in the ticket and we'll escalate.
